subject: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Apr 2027 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail

Hi Samantha —

Great to chat today — thanks for walking through the use case and the latency/cost targets. Quick recap and proposed mutual action plan so we keep momentum: 

Summary from call
- Primary use: in-product personalization and on-demand generative insights for merchandising.
- Expected steady-state throughput: ~120 requests/min, spikes to ~400 for promo windows.
- Data handling: no PII sent to model; only product IDs + anonymized signals.

Procurement path (what we heard)
1) Legal review (contract terms & DPA) — Acme legal
2) Security questionnaire & evidence (SOC2 summary, network topology) — Acme security
3) Finance approval (budget + PO issuance) — Acme finance
4) PO issuance or card/marketplace purchase — final step

Options we discussed
- PO (preferred for finance) — 30–60 day cycle case
- Corporate card (faster) — limited to small pilots / evals
- Marketplace (AWS Marketplace) — useful long-term but requires marketplace setup and usually adds procurement overhead on your side

Proposed milestones (rough dates)
- 2027-04-22: We share draft SOW + MAP and security evidence (attached)
- 2027-04-26: Legal marks and redlines back to Redwood
- 2027-04-30: Security Q completed / SOC2 evidence accepted
- 2027-05-05: Finance sign-off or PO issued (target)

Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf, SOW-acme-draft.docx (see attached draft materials).

Can you confirm that the above reflects what your team heard and whether the milestone dates look reasonable? If PO will be required, who in finance should we loop in now?

Thanks — I’ll prepare a one-page MAP for your procurement team and tentatively schedule a brief sync for next Tuesday (4/26) for legal redlines.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0123

From: Samantha Li <samantha@acmeretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Wed, 21 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail

Dylan — thanks for the clear recap and the docs. This matches our internal view. A couple of clarifications from our side: 

1) Legal: I’ll route the SOW to Legal (Susan Park) today. Expect initial redlines by 4/26 — legal typically needs 3 business days for first pass but will confirm.
2) Security: we run a standard vendor security assessment. If you can provide the SOC2 summary, encryption at rest details, and a simple network diagram, that will speed things. We have a security review slot the week of 4/26; I’ll aim to have them return questions by 4/30.
3) Finance: We do prefer a PO for anything above $10k monthly. I’ll introduce Alex Chen (Finance) once Legal gives the green light. If a short pilot on card helps us move faster, we might do a 30-day pilot on card while legal finishes the long-form SOW.

PO timing: realistically, if Legal & Security clear on the timelines above, Finance is likely to issue a PO by the first week of May. If there are significant legal redlines, that timeline slips — I’ll flag.

Samantha
Samantha Li
Head of Merchant Integrations | Acme Retail
+1 212-555-0987

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@acmeretail.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 22 Apr 2027 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail

Thanks Samantha — super helpful. We attached a short security evidence packet (SOC2 summary + encryption note + 1-page network diagram) and an updated one-page MAP with clear owners and acceptance criteria.

Updated ask and owners
- Legal redlines: Redwood to accept initial redlines by 4/28 (owner: Ben Carter)
- Security review: Redwood to answer questionnaire and supply additional logs if requested by 4/30 (owner: Evelyn Hart)
- Finance prep: we’ll send a cost summary + implementation milestones to Alex once Legal signals (owner: Dylan Brooks)

Pilot vs full PO plan
- Option A: 30-day paid pilot via corporate card to validate integration; sign long-form SOW post-PO. Owner: Acme finance and Dylan.
- Option B: Full PO to Redwood for initial 3-month commitment; Redwood to provide invoice + standard payment terms. Owner: Acme finance and Ben.

Can you confirm who in finance (name + email) we should include when the time comes? I’ll also book the 4/26 30-min legal sync for 10:00am PT — I’ll send a calendar invite with dial-in.

Regards,
Dylan

--
Attachments: Redwood-MAP-v1.pdf (updated), Redwood-security-summary.pdf

From: Samantha Li <samantha@acmeretail.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Michael Torres <michael.torres@acmeretail.com>, procurement@acmeretail.com
Date: Fri, 23 Apr 2027 11:17:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail

Dylan / Ben — quick update after internal triage: 

- Legal (Susan) confirmed the 4/26 sync and will bring initial redlines.
- Security confirmed they will run the questionnaire week of 4/26 and asked for any STIX/CERT or vulnerability disclosure details (if you have them, please attach).
- Finance: Alex Chen (alex.chen@acmeretail.com) will be the PO approver. He asked that we send a one-page price summary and invoice terms by 4/28 so he can put it on the finance review queue.

Request from procurement: can Redwood provide a single-line invoice amount for the 3-month commitment (Option B) and a separate line for pilot pricing (Option A)? That will speed Alex’s review. Also let us know if AWS Marketplace is an option for licensing; Alex flagged that marketplace purchases need additional registration and may add 7–10 days.

If we can get the price summary and a slightly tightened MAP doc by 4/28, the team expects to be able to issue a PO by 5/05, assuming no major redlines.

Thanks — Samantha

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samantha Li <samantha@acmeretail.com>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 25 Apr 2027 09:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Next steps & procurement gate checklist — Redwood + Acme Retail

Appreciate the speedy coordination, Samantha. Per request, attached is a clean one-page price summary and a single-line 3-month invoice estimate plus a separate pilot line. Evelyn — can you prepare a 2-week onboarding plan and an initial SKO checklist so we can include it in the SOW?

Next actions (owners & dates)
- 2027-04-28: Redwood send finalized 1-pg price summary + MAP (owner: Ben Carter)
- 2027-04-28: Acme Legal redlines meeting (owner: Susan Park)
- 2027-04-30: Security Q completed (owner: Evelyn Hart / Acme security)
- 2027-05-05: Target PO issuance (owner: Alex Chen / Acme Finance)

I’ll also open the HubSpot deal (link below) and attach the latest SOW draft so Alex has one place to review. If the PO path slips, we’re ok to proceed with a 30-day pilot on card to keep momentum — Dylan and I can coordinate billing.

HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/7890123

Thanks — looking forward to the 4/26 sync.

Best,
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
